batch_config.name: ode_epsilon_floor_refinement_scan_v1
batch_config.purpose: Refine around previously identified near-floor candidates to determine whether the floor behaves as a tight oscillatory band, a convergent point, or a parameter-shifting lower bound.

paper_alignment.primary_question: What is the detailed structure of the near-floor regime in the local epsilon-rho-R system?
paper_alignment.hypothesis_under_test: Case B: the system approaches a narrow oscillatory band near the floor rather than a static fixed lower bound.

core_measurement_policy.naming_rule: Do not assign any formal lexical name to derived units or floor quantities in outputs.

candidate_reference_policy.source: Use the top candidates from the prior floor extraction batch as anchors for refinement.
candidate_reference_policy.agent_rule: Read epsilon_floor_summary.csv or top_floor_candidate_runs.csv if available and select the lowest epsilon_floor_estimate cases with narrow bandwidths as refinement centers.
candidate_reference_policy.fallback_if_candidate_files_unavailable: Use the lowest-k, highest-suppression, zero-support parameter combinations from the prior scan as provisional centers.

initial_condition_families.name: micro_perturbation_pair
initial_condition_families.notes: Used to estimate whether nearby initial conditions collapse into the same band or remain distinguishable.

scan_stages.goal: Perform a tight local parameter box scan around each selected near-floor candidate.
scan_stages.agent_instruction: For each selected candidate center, scan ±10% around each active parameter using 5-point local spacing.
scan_stages.expected_value: Determines whether the candidate floor is locally stable in parameter space or shifts sharply.

scan_stages.goal: Extend the horizon to see whether the near-floor band tightens, drifts, or persists.
scan_stages.expected_value: Separates transient apparent floor behavior from sustained near-floor structure.

scan_stages.goal: Check whether the near-floor bandwidth is numerical or dynamical.
scan_stages.expected_value: If bandwidth shrinks strongly with dt, it may be numerical. If it persists, it is more likely dynamical.

scan_stages.goal: Estimate the smallest stable distinguishable increment above the floor candidate.
scan_stages.expected_value: Supports delta_epsilon_min_resolved estimation and tests whether nearby starts merge into one band.

analysis_rules.epsilon_floor_estimate_rule: Estimate epsilon_floor from the final-window mean when the trajectory remains bounded and non-runaway.
analysis_rules.near_floor_oscillation_amplitude_rule: Use half the peak-to-peak epsilon amplitude in the final window.
analysis_rules.near_floor_convergent_rule: If final-window bandwidth and std both shrink below threshold and continue shrinking with longer t_final and smaller dt, classify as near_floor_convergent.
analysis_rules.near_floor_oscillatory_rule: If final-window bandwidth remains positive and stable under longer t_final and smaller dt, classify as near_floor_oscillatory.
analysis_rules.delta_epsilon_min_resolved_rule: Estimate from the smallest pair of nearby initial conditions that remain distinguishable in final-window statistics under the same refined parameter set.

minimum_success_conditions: At least one near-floor candidate is shown to persist as an oscillatory band or convergent point under refinement.
dt and horizon sensitivity are explicitly characterized.
A preliminary estimate of delta_epsilon_min_resolved is produced.
target_figures: best-candidate time series with final-window highlight
bandwidth vs dt for top candidate
bandwidth vs t_final for top candidate

notes_to_agent: Prioritize the lowest epsilon_floor_estimate candidates from the previous batch.
This batch is about characterization, not discovery of entirely new regions.
If the best candidates remain oscillatory with stable positive bandwidth under smaller dt and longer t_final, explicitly state support for the oscillatory-band hypothesis in diagnostic_note.md.
Negative rho values must be flagged and not silently treated as physically meaningful.
All run ids should include stage_id and candidate_id.
